balls.text: low full toss at shin height on fifth stump, slices this wide of long-off for two.
yorker on middle, Roy shuffles across and gets on a knee to scoop this but can't clear short fine leg, goes for a single collected on a bounce.
yorker on leg stump follows Roy backing away, jams this out back to the bowler.

slower length ball angled across fifth stump, Harshit misses swishing at this. They try to pinch a bye to get Roy back on strike. Klaasen's flick at the stumps misses badly but Natarajan backs up the throw from Klaasen well and fires at the non-striker's end to catch Harshit a yard short.

another sparkling catch this innings, this time from Abdul Samad at deep midwicket!  Knee high full toss on off, Rinku tries to muscle this over the leg side but miscues it too flat allowing Samad to charge in 15 yards off the rope and dive forward full extension to latch on at shin height before sticking the landing sliding along the turf.
full and wide, driven straight to extra cover for none.
full on the stumps, heaves this to deep midwicket for one.
full and wide, driven along the turf down the ground for one.
length ball on fourth stump, heaves this through wide long-on, this time getting the boundary where he intended to on the previous ball.
length ball outside off, slices a thick edge between the keeper and short third to the rope.
good length ball pushed away for one.
full on fourth stump, driven to wide long-off for another jogged two.
low full toss at ankle height on sixth stump, driven wide of long-off for two.
full on fifth stump, whipped along the ground to long-on for one.
132 kph low full toss on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
length ball on seventh stump, slapped high toward the cover sweeper Abdul Samad who jogs in casually 10 yards off the rope and takes this catch at thigh height reaching forward in stride.
thigh high full toss at 134 kph heaved just short of deep midwicket for one.
length ball on eighth stump, heaved to wide long-on for two.
short and wide, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
full on middle, Rinku charges and launches a drive a mile high and deep over long-on landing 20 rows back.
full and wide on the guideline, toe-edges a slog that floats short of long-off for one.
good length googly floated on fourth stump, Rinku charges initially before going back to cut to the sweeper for one.
full on the legs, sweeps this along the ground to deep square leg for one.
full on off, flicked along the ground to long-on for one.
111 kph slower length ball on fifth stump, goes for a booming drive back down the ground but misses.

nearly another spectacular catch by Markram! Fullish length ball on leg stump, backs away to punch this high over mid-off. Markram runs back from the ring and reaches out at the last moment while tumbling to the ground and gets fingertips to this with his right hand but it lands safely for two.
127 kph good length ball straying too far down leg past a flick, wide called.
good length ball straying on the legs, flicked effortlessly behind square leg to the rope.

slower ball at 114 kph on sixth stump on a good length, Narine is badly fooled through the shot early and tries to check his drive but makes too much contact with the shot and sends the ball floating softly to Agarwal on the ring at extra cover, who shuffles a few yards left to take a chest high catch.
back of a length on fourth stump, sliced to deep point for one.
length ball on fifth stump, punched to mid-off for none.
short and wide, sliced to deep cover for one.
fullish length on off, chips this uppishly off the inner splice of the bat floating back just short of the bowler.
good length ball on off, defended to cover for none.
full outside off, driven along the ground to long-off for one.

this one is floated full again but much wider on eighth stump, Russell winds up for an almighty heave but can't quite reach it. Spices a top edge fluttering tamely to short third man on the ring, who slides forward to take the catch on his knees.
flighted full on middle and off, Russell goes to slog and miscues an inside edge into his feet.
full outside off, driven to long-off for one.
short and wide, muscles a cut high and wide of the cover sweeper, one bounce over the rope.
good length ball heaved to wide long-on for two.
good length ball flicked away for one.
another short ball tailing down leg for another wide.
short ball tailing down the leg side, wide called.
short and wide, sliced behind point, diving stop on the ring knocks this down for one.
length ball wide outside off, slapped wide of the cover sweeper for two.
short on the stumps, pulled through the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on to the rope.
back of a length on middle, goes back to defend.
zipped in flatter and quicker on a good length on middle, prodded into cover for one.
googly on a good length spins in and is defended to the leg side.
flighted too full on middle and leg stump, Russell clears the front leg and heaves this high and deep over wide long-on into the first row.
flighted full on middle, pushed back to Markande.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
full on sixth stump, width for Dre Russ to wind up and slam this flat over the bowler into the sightscreen at long-on.
good length ball on middle, goes back to defend.
flighted full on fourth stump, smothered on the front foot.

brilliant caught and bowled by Markram finished off at mid-on! Flighted full on fourth stump, Rana slogs trying to clear midwicket but it's a bit out of reach and produces a top edge swirling toward the edge of the ring. There's nobody in front of square in the leg side ring. The nearest fielder is at long-on. Markram recognizes this immediately and sprints backwards 20+ yards before flinging himself toward the edge of the circle at mid-on to cling onto a stunning effort. The judges from Switzerland, Mexico, Aruba, Fiji, Indonesia, Benin and North Macedonia all hold up 10 marks out of 10 on their cards.
length ball on seventh stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
short outside off, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
short on seventh stump, goes back to pull through wide long-on for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended to the off side.
good length ball on off, punched to long-off for one.
good length on off, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
full on the stumps, flicked away for one.

148 kph yorker on fifth stump is shoveled out to backward point. Appeal is made for a catch. Rana stands his ground claiming it was a bump ball. It's been sent to the third umpire. Live, it looked like it hit ground, then bat and flew to the fielder as a legal catch. This is so tight on the replays. This is going to be the Rorschach Test of replays. You'll see what you want to see. Third umpire uses UltraEdge though as the decisive piece of evidence to demonstrate sound waves that the ball hit the ground after it came off the bat. Not out.
full on sixth stump at 146 kph, goes to drive and is beaten for pace
short on off at 134 kph, pulled much flatter and more fiercely over square leg clearing the rope with authoritah! 77-meter strike.
136 kph short on the stumps, short arm jab pulls this high and deep over deep square leg just barely clearing the boundary rider and landing in between the rope and the LCD ad boards.
back of a length on fifth stump, guided intentionally wide of the keeper with an open face very fine to the deep third rope.
length ball on seventh stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
full on the legs, goes to sweep and this grazes the gloves past the keeper to short fine leg for a single.

Rinku stays in the crease this time rocking back quickly expecting a short ball as overcompensation from Markram and he spanks this short and wide ball on eighth stump wide of the cover sweeper to the rope past a diving effort from the boundary rider.
Rinku charges down the pitch and carves this full ball from fifth stump inside out over extra cover to the rope.
full outside off, driven to long-off for one
good length ball on the legs, flicked into midwicket off the pads for a leg bye.
full on the legs, sweeps this along the ground to deep square leg for one.
yorker on off, jammed out to long-on for one.
134 kph delivery lands full and wide, punched firmly to cover on the ring for none.
back of a length on eighth stump, slapped to mid-off for none.
133 kph good length ball on off, shuffles across to flick into midwicket for one.
length ball on the hips, shuffles across to whip a pull flat over deep backward square leg landing seven rows back.
good length ball on the stumps, defended.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked through square leg for one.
the crowd erupts! For a ball that beats the outside edge... good length ball on fourth stump straightens to beat a back foot flick.
back of a length on off, goes back to flick to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on off, goes back to flick to long-on for one.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked into midwicket for one.
full on fourth stump, punched to wide long-off for one.
short ball on off, fended off awkwardly into cover for none.
knee high full toss on fifth stump, firmly punched wide of mid-off but a diving stop on the ring keeps this to one.
140 kph delivery again lands back of a length on fifth stump, tapped away for one.
135 kph delivery back of a length on seventh stump, taps this with an open face to deep third for one.
back of a length on the legs, tapped gently this time into mid-on for one.
good length on the legs, flicked to deep backward square leg and beats short fine leg in the ring to the rope.
overpitched on off, pumps a drive back down the ground through mid-off to the rope.
137 kph bouncer over leg stump, wide called on height from the square leg ump.
back of a length on the legs, goes back to flick to midwicket and a leading edge goes to point for none.

identical back of a length ball but this time tighter on fifth stump, Roy tries to repeat a cross bat heave and produces another top edge but this time does not clear short third man on the ring and a simple catch is taken at head height.
length ball just inside the wide guideline, slashes this high over short third and backspins away to the rope.
143 kph back of a length ball just inside the wide guideline outside off, Roy charges and then leaves it alone hoping for a wide that doesn't come.

length ball on eighth stump, skies a slog behind the stumps off a top edge that swirls over the keeper. Klaasen takes the catch but the ball was in the air for so long that they're able to scamper a sharp two on the free hit.
back of a length at 135 kph wide outside off, too wide to play at beyond the guidelines and another wide is called. Siren goes off. Misdemeanor upgraded to a no ball felony. Free hit to come.
full and swinging away outside the wide guideline out of reach of a drive, wide called.
135 kph delivery lands back of a length on sixth stump, Rana pushes at this with hard hands and is beaten.
full on fourth stump, flicked to mid-on for none.
136 kph bouncer over off stump, Rana ducks out of the way of this.
back of a length on the stumps at 139 kph, goes back to flick through the ring for one to deep square leg.
back of a length on off, flicked into midwicket for a sharp single.
back of a length on off, Rana backs away to heave to the leg side but misses.
yorker straying on the legs, flicked out through deep backward square leg to the rope. Siren goes off and a free hit will come for Rana.
back of a length on sixth stump, defended to cover for none.
back of a length on seventh stump, slices this tamely to cover for none.
Roy charges a wide yorker on eighth stump, jammed out to backward point for none.
length ball wide outside off on eighth stump, Roy slaps this through cover to the rope.
133 kph delivery lands back of a length on seventh stump, slapped to cover on the ring for none.
back of a length on sixth stump, goes back to punch and is beaten.

bounced out! Bangs this in short on middle at 137 kph, Iyer continues to look uncomfortable v Jansen and tries to hook this defensively while turtling his head out of the way and gloves this up in the air popping up to carry gently through to Klaasen.
back of a length on the legs, flicked in front of square leg for one.
length ball on the legs at 134 kph, flicked through square leg and chased down short of the rope by Kartik Tyagi to keep this to three.

gem of a ball from Jansen goes unrewarded! Back of a length at 137 kph nips away a touch on fourth stump with extra bounce and clips the shoulder of the bat with Iyer playing back, a thick outside edge goes just wide of slip to the deep third rope.
full on off, defended back down the pitch to Jansen.

length ball on off at 133 kph, Gurbaz tries to flick this over midwicket but Jansen hustles him for pace and he's a fraction late on the shot producing a top edge that swirls over mid-on. Brook settles under this inside the ring and takes a simple chest high catch with his arms tucked into his body.
good length ball on the hips pings Roy on the thigh late on a flick and trickles behind him just wide of the stumps.
good length ball on off, blocked back down the pitch to mid-on for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, Roy swats this through wide midwicket to the rope.
fullish length ball outside off, driven in the air flat just short of the man at short cover diving forward, it slips underneath him and goes to the rope.
good length ball on seventh stump swinging away at 131 kph, left alone.
KKR pull off quite the heist! Varun zips in a quicker ball very short on middle at 107 kph, too quick for Bhuvi to react and he flails badly missing a flat-footed pull.
full on middle, in the slot to whack but Markande miscues an attempted shovel tamely landing well short of long-on and they jog a casual one.

good length ball on fifth stump, goes across the stumps trying to scoop over fine leg and misses. Appeal for a stumping as Markande stumbled a bit after missing the shot. Markande was fine though with his back foot down in plenty of time.

length ball on leg stump, tries to slaughter this over the leg side but doesn't get the elevation and picks out the boundary rider at deep midwicket taking this coolly at head height three yards inside the rope. The crowd went nuts when the ball left the bat thinking it was going for a certain six but Anukul Roy was there to intercept it and the crowd falls into a hush.
good length ball slanted into the pads outside leg stump, misses a flick and it dribbles away for a leg bye behind square.
length ball on fourth stump, slapped to wide long-on for one.
knee high full toss on fifth stump, Samad advances down the wicket to meet this 142 kph delivery and punch along the turf to long-on for one.
wide yorker on the guidelines, plays over the top of a drive after shuffling well outside off.

full and wide way outside the off stump guideline, slices a drive high over short third and backspins away to the rope. The Siren goes off to make the home crowd go further berserk. Another delivery and free hit to come. Massive error at the worst time for KKR. Arora was on the line, not behind it on landing.
yorker on off, jammed out to long-off for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, sliced to short third man for none.
full and wide slower ball in the slot at 127 kph, Bhuvi shovels a drive in the air just out of the reach of extra cover on the ring and it bounces away to the rope.

142 kph inswinging yorker on sixth stump, Jansen tries to drive this out and there's a noise through to the keeper diving left. Appeal from the keeper Gurbaz is upheld and Jansen walks. Sure enough on replays there's a thin inside edge which caused Gurbaz to have to dive leg side.

bouncer over off stump, beats Jansen hooking. Wide called from square leg on height. KKR challenge this on DRS wanting it to be overturned for a legal delivery scrapping for every run.  Replays clearly show it was sailing over Jansen's head. Wide is upheld.

missed runout! Good length ball on off, sliced to backward point. The non-striker bolts but is sent back. He's stuck mid-pitch but a relay from backward point is wild and Varun is in poor position to collect it not being over the stumps either. A simple relay would have had Jansen out by six yards.
good length speared onto middle and leg, can't fight this off through cover in a gap and finds a fielder for none.
good length ball slanted across fifth stump, misses a cut.
good length ball on sixth stump, tapped gently wide of long-off and they scamper a tight two.
goes for another reverse sweep to a ball tailing past his legs and misses, no wide called as the ball goes off the keeper to short fine leg for a bye.

good length ball on middle, Jansen goes to reverse paddle this and misses off the pads deflecting to short fine leg. They scamper a very tight two as the fielder charging in from deep fine leg can't deny a second.
short and wide, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
slower bouncer on sixth stump, Markram tries to tennis overhead smash this but pings it high to long-off. Simple catch for Rinku camping under this 12 yards inside the rope at head height.
short and wide, slices this to backward point, diving stop on the ring keeps this to one.
back of a length on off, punched to extra cover for one.
good length ball on off, pushes down the ground for one.
full outside off, pumps a drive wide of long-off and beats the boundary rider to the rope.
full on fourth stump, miscues a heave into short mid-on fielded by the bowler for one.
full on sixth stump, slapped to long-off for one.
length ball on fifth stump, slapped straight to extra cover for none.
good length ball on fourth stump, flicked to long-on for one.
good length ball on the body, can't flick it away.
good length ball on sixth stump, sliced to the off side for one.
136 kph length ball on fifth stump, Samad charges and laces a scorching drive on the up wide of extra cover to the rope.
back of a length on off, defended to the off side.
slower short ball on off, pulled through the leg side for one.
135 kph full in the slot on fifth stump, punched through wide mid-off past a diving effort to the rope.
full on the stumps, driven in the air down the ground for one.

133 kph delivery on a fullish length on fourth stump, Klaasen tries to heave this over midwicket but gets it more off the splice and picks out Russell on the rope at deep midwicket. Catch taken three yards inside the rope at head height.
back of length on middle, backs away to cut to the sweeper for one.
full on off, flicked to long-on for one.
full on middle, Markram reverse sweeps this sweetly over backward point, Russell runs along the rope and fails to slap this back into play.
back of a length on the hips, flicked behind square leg for one.
good length ball on off, flicked to deep midwicket for one this time.
full on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for two.
back of a length on the hips, whips this off the body high over fine leg landing 15 rows back just short of the second tier.
slower ball lands full on fifth stump, driven to long-on for one.
full on the legs tailing down the leg side past a flick for a wide.
back of a length on sixth stump, sliced to deep third for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, slices a drive in the air to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on the stumps, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
length ball on seventh stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on off, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
back of a length on middle, goes back to punch to long-on for two.
short on seventh stump, cuts this again past backward point and beats Russell running around from cover sweeper to the rope.
short and wide, slices a cut behind point that backspins wide of the sweeper to the rope.
good length ball on off, punched to the off side for none.
short on the legs, paddle pulled behind square leg for one.
good length ball on off, punched to long-off for one.
into the second tier! Full on middle, heaves this into the upper deck over deep square leg.
full on middle, punched along the ground for one.
full and wide, driven to extra cover for none.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
full on fifth stump, goes to drive this a mile high and deep over long-off sailing into the crowd.
back of a length punched to long-off for one.
back of a length flicked to long-on for one.
short outside off, punched away to cover for none.
good length ball on off, punched to long-off for one.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to deep backward square leg for one.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to deep square leg for one.
good length ball on off, punched to deep cover for one.
good length ball on middle, defended to extra cover.
good length ball on middle, goes to flick to midwicket and a leading edge goes to backward point for none.
full on middle, punched back to the bowler for none.
full on middle, goes back to flick to deep midwicket for one.
full on middle and leg, flicked to long-on for one.
bouncer on off, ducked under and left alone.
another short ball on the body pulled to deep fine leg for one.
short on the legs, pulled to deep backward square leg for one.
back of a length on the stumps, slapped to long-on for one.
back of a length on the stumps defended.
good length ball on leg stump, punched to wide long-on for two.
good length ball on seventh stump, slapped to cover for none.
short on off, goes back and pulls flat over midwicket to the rope.
good length ball on middle, flicked to long-on for one.
good length ball sliding past the pads down leg for a wide.
good length ball on fifth stump, slapped to cover sweeper for one.

full on off stump, Brook shuffles across his stumps to scoop this over fine leg but misses. Big lbw shout denied. They take a run and Nitish huddles with the bowler to go for DRS.  There was a lot happening on the initial appeal where glove was close to hip. But it misses the glove on replay and comes off the side of the hip crouched low with impact in line with middle stump. Ball-tracking shows this going on to hit leg stump. Decision overturned. Brook's lean run since his century continues with another duck.
good length ball on middle, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, defended back to the bowler.
back of a length on fourth stump, tapped to short third for none.
bouncer on sixth stump, left alone.

Tripathi outfoxes himself! Shuffles across his stumps to a slower ball at 116 kph landing full on middle, Tripathi tries to scoop this over fine leg but the fielder was on the rope instead of being up in the ring and he picks him out at head height five yards inside the rope for a basic catch.
full in the slog on fourth stump, Tripathi backs away to create room and slams a drive inside out over cover to the rope.

goes for yorker on leg stump but misfires a full toss at shin height at 136 kph that Tripathi flicks this over deep backward square leg sailing 77 meters over the rope hitting the facade of the second tier.

Tripathi shuffles forward and back before becoming stationary again to a length ball on off that is slashed over cover to the rope. Siren goes off to ID a no ball and a free hit will come. Russell was on the line but not behind it on landing.
back of a length on fifth stump, goes to drive and is beaten.

full on the stumps, punched right back to the bowler who fields and flings at the stumps with a direct hit but Markram looked like he was back in. He is so comfortably. 30 seconds of our lives that we'll never get back going for a totally unnecessary third umpire review...
back of a length on fourth stump, defended to cover for none.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes back to flick to midwicket for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, goes back to flick wide of mid-on for one.
slower ball lands full on fifth stump, smokes a drive to mid-off for none.
full on fourth stump, miscued drive to mid-on for none.

the great catching continues in the second innings! Length ball on the hips, Abhishek goes to flick this over square leg but this climbs on him a touch and results in a skied chance toward deep backward square. Russell comes forward for this steepler and settles under it before lunging forward at the last moment to latch on.
back of a length on sixth stump, punched wide of cover for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, Tripathi shuffles well across his stumps to scoop this in the gap between the keeper and short fine leg to the rope.
back of a length on off, prodded to mid-off for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched wide of extra cover for two to the sweeper.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended to cover.

bounced out! Almost a carbon copy of how Jansen took a wicket in the first innings against Iyer. 139 kph delivery angled into the body on middle and leg stump. Mayank plays an almost identical shot to how Iyer got out, a defensive hook while trying to turtle his head out of the way for safety and the timid stroke attempt results in a gloved chance lobbing up behind the stumps gently to the keeper.
144 kph delivery full on the stumps, flicked straight to midwicket for none.
short on fourth stump, backs away from leg stump and flays a cut with tremendous timing that barely clears a deep point fielder on the rope.
good length ball on the stumps, goes back to flick into midwicket for none.
back of a length on the legs, goes back to flick over midwicket and misses off the body.
back of a length on fifth stump, goes back to punch through cover and a thick edge flies between the keeper and short third to the rope.
length ball on fifth stump, punched through cover for one.
length ball on seventh stump, slapped along the ground to a cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on the legs, misses a flick and it comes off the pads to square leg for one.

goes for yorker and sends down a shin high full toss on middle that is shoveled to Nitish Rana at mid-off. He spills the ball at neck height while trying to hurry a catch and throw all in one motion to deny a single off the free hit and they take it comfortably.

full in the slot on eighth stump, this time laces this in the air clearing extra cover, one bounce over the rope. To make matters worse for Vaibhav, the siren singles him out for overstepping by a good three inches. Free hit to come.
full on eighth stump, strides forward and punches firmly straight to extra cover on the ring.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to the off side.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to extra cover.
good length ball on the hips, goes back to flick and misses off the pads before it caroms to cover for a leg bye.
good length ball on fifth stump, goes to flick through mid-on and a thick inside edge goes to deep fine leg for two.
back of a length tailing down the leg side past the hips, wide called.
back of a length on the hips, flicked straight to deep fine leg for one.
full and wide, Abhishek tucks into a lofted drive clearing cover easily before bouncing over the rope.
